captions.detailed: A Victorian-era coastal garrison cannon featuring a heavy, dark cast-iron barrel mounted on a two-wheeled platform carriage. The carriage is built with dark grey side cheeks resting on a brown wooden base, flanked by two large, solid black iron wheels. A brass-colored traversing hand-wheel with a crank handle is mounted on the right side cheek of the carriage. The barrel pivots vertically on its trunnions, the side wheels rotate on their axle, and the hand-wheel rotates for aiming adjustments.
captions.instruction: Generate a Victorian coastal garrison cannon with a heavy cast-iron barrel, a two-wheeled platform carriage, and a brass traversing hand-wheel. Ensure the barrel has a revolute joint for elevation, the side wheels have revolute joints for rolling, and the hand-wheel has a revolute joint on the right side of the carriage.
captions.factory: Construct the base platform using a brown box primitive, and build up the carriage side cheeks using combined box extrusions. Model the cannon barrel using nested cylinders of varying radii to form the stepped muzzle, breech, and trunnions. Create the solid wheels from thin cylinders and the hand-wheel from a thin cylinder hub, spokes, and a rim. Define revolute joints for the barrel's trunnion axis, the wheel axles, and the hand-wheel shaft.
